feeds.title: Vantage Aging Blog
feeds.description: Uncover a positive perspective on aging, with Vantage Aging's blog showcase of helpful articles on the health and wellness of seniors. Read touching caregiver stories, inspiration, and other updates from the company. VANTAGE assists older adults with the challenges associated with wanting to remain in their own home as they age.

feeds.title: Kendal at Home Blog
feeds.description: From practical tips on home modifications and assistive technologies to advice on navigating the challenges of daily living, Kendal at Home provides resources to empower seniors and their loved ones in making informed decisions about their care and well-being. Kendal at Home is a unique life plan at-home program that empowers you to live the life you want, on your terms

feeds.title: Hudson Grande Senior Living Blog
feeds.description: View the latest news and blogs from Hudson Grande Senior Living in Hudson, Ohio! Whether you're considering senior living options for yourself or a loved one, or simply want to stay informed on healthy aging topics, we've got you covered.

feeds.title: The Knolls of Oxford Blog
feeds.description: Explore The Blog at The Knolls where you will find the latest information on senior living trends. Learn more about what life in the community is like by reading the latest engaging posts. The Knolls of Oxford is part of Maple Knoll Communities, Inc. a non-profit corporation that has been serving older adults since 1848.

feeds.title: The Courtyard at Ohio Blog
feeds.description: The Courtyard at Ohio presents an exquisite look at its assisted living facilities and senior activities through its blog coverage. Follow retirement home tips, senior life hacks and poignant stories. The Courtyard at Ohio communities are part of the Encore Senior Living family.

feeds.title: Rittenhouse Village At Gahanna Blog
feeds.description: Rittenhouse Village Gahanna is a top-rated Independent Living community in OH. Browse their senior living blog and learn to make the most of your retirement. Discover inspiring articles, practical tips, and valuable insights on various topics related to senior living, wellness, and staying active.

feeds.title: Episcopal Retirement Services Blog
feeds.description: Episcopal Retirement Service (ERS) has dedicated itself to improving the lives of older adults through innovative, quality living environments and in-home and community-based services delivered by experienced and compassionate professionals. ERS also operates in-home services such as their geriatric care management service, Living Well Senior Solutions.

feeds.title: OnShift Blog
feeds.description: Gather the latest workforce insights & strategies from top providers & industry experts. OnShift's award-winning blog features fresh best practices around recruiting, hiring, managing, and engaging senior care employees. OnShift is a Staff Scheduling & Labor Management software for long-term care & senior living.

feeds.title: The Inn at Belden Village Blog
feeds.description: Stay connected with your loved ones at the Inn at Belden Village via this blog. Explore a rush of fun activities for seniors, weekly spotlight, and other interesting stories. The Inn at Belden Village is one of Stark County's Top Senior Assisted Living Facilities.

feeds.title: Life Enriching Communities Blog
feeds.description: Uncover valuable insights, tips, and tools designed to help you and older adults smoothly navigate their old age care options and finances. Life Enriching Communities (LEC) is an integrated family of lifestyle communities and senior living services.

feeds.title: Brentwood Blog
feeds.description: Stay up-to-date on Brentwood news and activities by checking out the blog. Learn more about everything going on at our health care center. Brentwood Health Care Center (BHCC) is a 99-bed skilled nursing facility that specializes in short- and long-term rehabilitation, therapy, and assisted living.

feeds.title: Vitalia Rockside Blog
feeds.description: View the latest news and blogs from VITALIA® Rockside in Seven Hills, Ohio. Visit our website to learn more. Vitalia Rockside is a premier care facility providing quality villas, independent living, assisted living, and memory care in Seven Hills, OH.

feeds.title: LSS Senior Living Blog
feeds.description: The diligent staff at LSS Senior Living is dedicated to providing resources to help you and your family learn more about the best senior living options. Explore their recent blog posts to learn more about senior living options, how to navigate the decision-making process, and discover what sets LSS communities apart.

feeds.title: Genesis Village Blog
feeds.description: Read the Village Voice blog to keep in touch with the fulfilling lifestyle of seniors at Genesis Village community. Get help in identifying the right Caregiver community, Tips for senior health and happiness, and Wonderful stories about seniors living at the Genesis Village active senior living community.

feeds.title: Judson Senior Living Blog
feeds.description: Check out all the latest news, blog posts, and events from Judson Services. Get a glimpse into the vibrant community and engagement activities happening over at Judson Senior Living through constant updates. Judson Services, Inc., is a not-for-profit, interdenominational organization providing engaging and comfortable lifestyles for seniors.

feeds.title: Mallard Cove Blog
feeds.description: Step into a world of care and connection with Mallard Cove's blog, your go-to source for the pulse of the Assisted Living Facility. Stay informed, engaged, and empowered with in-depth articles that cover Finances, Nursing assessments, Festive activities and news updates.

feeds.title: Generations Healthcare Management Blog
feeds.description: Generations Healthcare Management's official blog shines a spotlight on the diverse array of social, cultural, and recreational activities that bring residents together, fostering lasting friendships and cherished memories. Generations Senior Living is a family-owned organization dedicated to the spirit of independence.

feeds.title: Ohio CEUs Blog
feeds.description: Ohio CEUs is an education company dedicated to quality courses, affordable prices, and efficient programming. Recent articles on their blog discuss the latest in Nursing Home technology and guidance for administrators who work with older adults. Stay tuned and informed.

feeds.title: BrookHaven Blog
feeds.description: Browse resources from the Brookhaven Retirement Community staff educating and informing readers of vital facts about Independent Living, Assisted Living, and Skilled Nursing. Learn how to choose the right living community for your loved one.

feeds.title: The Grove at Oakleaf Village Blog
feeds.description: Take a peek inside life at The Grove via weekly blog reports, You'll also discover vital insights, tips, and inspiration regarding Senior Living. The Grove is a state-of-the-art, freestanding community on the campus of Oakleaf Village, exclusively designed for seniors with age-related dementias.

feeds.title: Northeast Ohio Thrive
feeds.description: Northeast Ohio Boomer is published by Mitchell Media LLC in Hudson, Ohio by an exceptionally talented and passionate team of local media professionals. Their guiding principle, 'Thrive After 55,' celebrates this region as a positive place to age successfully in the second half of life.

feeds.title: Otterbein Blog
feeds.description: Otterbein SeniorLife's blogs provide an exclusive look into what it's like living at Otterbein's vibrant campuses, as well as topics such as senior lifestyle, wellness, services, and more. Otterbein SeniorLife offers seniors unlimited lifestyle options through independent living, assisted living, skilled nursing, rehab, and hospice services.
